title: Graphon Limits of Graph Reaction--Diffusion Equations
summary: A graph reaction--diffusion (RD) equation is a system of differential equations that is defined on the nodes of a graph. Consider a sequence of growing graphs that converges in cut norm to a limiting graphon. We show that the solutions of the sequence of graph RD equations converge in $L^p$ norm, for $p \in [1,\infty]$, to the solution of a limiting nonlocal RD equation, which we call a graphon RD equation.
